description: Single-source registry for skill activation metadata, descriptions, domain chains, and scenarios.

layers.title: Universal Methodology
layers.positioning: Project-agnostic engineering craft, complexity budgets, falsification, debugging, caching, and statistical telemetry.

layers.title: Workspace Governance
layers.positioning: Unified commit, gate, skill, rule-catalog, docs-archive, release, subagent, and test-benchmark invariants.

layers.title: Domain Adapters
layers.positioning: Subsystem-specific rules and workflows for auto-refactor, fractal-git (Taxis), workspace-timing, WebGames, and Rust.

algorithmic-operator-engineering.pitch: Apply 5-step SoA/LUT complexity reduction and differential parity verification on hot-loop bottlenecks.
algorithmic-operator-engineering.purpose: Drop algorithmic complexity via SoA inversion, LUTs, and single-pass fusion backed by byte-parity microbenchmarks.
situations: An operator hits O(n^2) slowdown on large repos
Object-heavy loops need TypedArray/SoA layout inversion
Optimized native code needs byte-parity proof against baseline

auto-refactor-dev.pitch: Govern auto-refactor 6-layer engine, Rust/TS byte parity, Stage 0-3 analyzers, Praxis SDK, and telemetry guards.
auto-refactor-dev.purpose: Ensure engine/analyzer edits preserve Rust+TS parity, PathClassifier SSOT, project neutrality, and gate ratchets.
situations: Add or split a built-in analyzer without losing Rust/TS parity
Audit telemetry ingesters or preset-based trajectory plugins
Run gate:rust, vitest unit suite, and native parity checks
verification: cd auto-refactor && npm run build && npm run gate && npm test

batch-commit.pitch: Plan 6-layer atomic commits, strip forbidden prose, enforce 5D diff bounds, and run offline commit-msg gates.
batch-commit.purpose: Split multi-file changes into revertible atomic commits while avoiding forbidden terms and parallel-session bleed.
situations: Split cross-layer changes into clean revertible batches
Fix commit-msg-gate rejections or STAGED-DIFF-14 overflows
Stage explicit files safely beside active parallel sessions

coding-craft.pitch: Enforce contract naming, explicit errors, exhaustive types, minimal exports, and unidirectional dependencies.
coding-craft.purpose: Apply language-agnostic function/module craft aligned with 536 SSOT rules on every code write or review.
situations: Design exported APIs with explicit Result/typed-error semantics
Eliminate empty catches, any casts, and cyclic module imports
Audit exports and dependency direction across layers

complexity-budget.pitch: Enforce CC<=15, Depth<=4, ELOC<=900, LOC<=1400, 6-field JSDoc, and zero loop allocations when splitting hot files.
complexity-budget.purpose: Compress nested branches into guard clauses and decompose oversized modules while eliminating VOL-DOC-001 alerts.
situations: Split >= 800 ELOC files cleanly within dual-track budgets
Flatten nested conditionals to early-return guard clauses
Add 6-field headers to resolve VOL-DOC-001 volume notices

constraint-driven-development.pitch: Run Floor Guard ratchets and adversarial Doubt loops before delivery; forbid baseline weakening or partial hacks.
constraint-driven-development.purpose: Falsify edge assumptions and verify complete, unrelaxed gates before claiming completion or merging.
situations: Stress-test boundary assumptions before final merge verdict
Prevent threshold lowering or skipped assertions under failures
Verify zero placeholders, 0-byte files, or leftover TODOs

debugging-and-error-recovery.pitch: Debug via Observe-Hypothesize-SSCCE-MinimalFix and strict stop-after-2-failures discipline without guesswork.
debugging-and-error-recovery.purpose: Isolate root causes with minimal reproducible harnesses and halt guessing after two failed fix attempts.
situations: Pinpoint intermittent test or runtime crashes with an SSCCE
Halt speculative edits after two failed fix hypotheses
Trace regression origin cleanly before patching production code

defensive-security-and-taint-safety.pitch: Guard recursive deletes (GUARD-DESTR-001), read-only auto vars (GUARD-VAR-001), junctions, and taint boundaries.
defensive-security-and-taint-safety.purpose: Enforce 3-step destination taint proofs before rm/cleanup and block credential leaks or traversal vectors.
situations: Validate staging/worktree cleanup paths before recursive remove
Check Windows NTFS junctions before pruning temporary worktrees
Prevent $HOME/$PID overwrites and external-input injection

docs-archive-governance.pitch: Maintain blueprints, milestone archives, and end-user READMEs with live relative links and zero jargon.
docs-archive-governance.purpose: Keep top-level architecture blueprints and delivery records free of dead links, absolute paths, and internal slang.
situations: Archive completed phase outcomes into roadmap artifacts
Purge drive letters, file:// URIs, or broken relative links
Keep user-facing changelogs free of engineering jargon

facade-discipline.pitch: Dissolve <=3-line pure trampolines (ARCH-ABS-001), pack >=4 args, and enforce substantive frozen facades (>=15 ELOC).
facade-discipline.purpose: Replace empty passthrough wrappers with cohesive domain facades carrying validation, freezing, or contract checks.
situations: Inline trivial index/lib trampolines adding indirection without logic
Enrich Rust crate or TS module facades above >= 15 ELOC floor
Collapse >= 4 positional parameters into typed immutable options

fractal-git-dev.pitch: Govern fractal-git 10-crate topology, multi-hash Oid, PackWindowReader, CCD v2 poset merge, and taxis subcommands.
fractal-git-dev.purpose: Keep Taxis crates unidirectional, Git Plumbing byte-identical across 57 parity vectors, and CAS index trees lock-free.
situations: Implement or fix taxis Git drop-in commands (switch/stash/worktree)
Update fg-core::Oid multi-hash codecs or windowed PackFile readers
Maintain CCD v2 poset conflict detection and 3-part // SAFETY: proofs

gate-governance.pitch: Enforce Tier 1/1.5/2 gates, single-pass pre-commit streaming, pwsh/bash cwd isolation, and step-registry closure.
gate-governance.purpose: Align PowerShell 7+, Bash, and Node gate scripts with remote Linux sandbox orchestration and zero-bleed execution.
situations: Update single-pass gate-differential-bounds.js --stream hooks
Debug pwsh vs bash parity mismatches or cwd isolation errors
Run Tier 1.5 remote-sandbox-test before cross-OS batched pushes

interaction-design-physics.pitch: Enforce dark lightness steps, single-border CSS, damped spring motion, power-law vignettes, and IME compose locks.
interaction-design-physics.purpose: Eliminate nested borders, layout thrash, and premature IME submits via physical animation and dark-UI math.
situations: Fix nested pill borders or jarring white outlines in dark mode
Block Enter submission while CJK IME composition is active
Replace linear fades with critically damped motion curves

praxis-vfs-and-trajectory-learning.pitch: Govern LayerVFS CAS forks, 3-ply MCTS exploration, AAS auto-fix transforms, and preset trajectory plugins.
praxis-vfs-and-trajectory-learning.purpose: Ensure zero-spill sandbox search, real before/after quality deltas, and project-neutral trajectory recipe extraction.
situations: Run 3-ply MCTS multi-step patches with baseline snapshot diffs
Wire AAS actionable.patch transforms (SIM-TRN-001, HYG-WRAP-001)
Load project trajectory rules cleanly from preset JSON plugins

release-package-workflow.pitch: Build VSIX bundles, run -HotSync rotation, bump semver cleanly, and align Keep-a-Changelog user release notes.
release-package-workflow.purpose: Keep extension packaging, registry self-healing, and public release notes synchronized and jargon-free.
situations: Package updated VSIX and run -HotSync across IDE targets
Synchronize CHANGELOG entries after version bumps
Verify extension display assets and package hygiene

rule-catalog-governance.pitch: Maintain single-source rule-catalog.json (536 rules), 3-3-3 IDs, family taxonomy, and RCFG-RULE-DRIFT closure.
rule-catalog-governance.purpose: Prevent unregistered rule IDs, cross-project count drift, and diagnostic/presentation deduplication coupling.
situations: Register new rule IDs across analyzer, catalog, and skill taxonomy
Run sync-doc-metrics.js --write after catalog or skill changes
Fix RCFG-RULE-DRIFT or rule-family-taxonomy count mismatches

rust-engineering.pitch: Enforce Type-State, thiserror errors, zero panics/loop alloc, 3-part // SAFETY: proofs, and Clippy -D warnings.
rust-engineering.purpose: Hold Rust crates in auto-refactor and fractal-git to zero-panic, zero-warning, proven-unsafe standards.
situations: Audit unsafe blocks for Preconditions/Invariants/Postconditions
Replace bare panic/unwrap and &String params in production code
Pass strict workspace cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

skill-governance.pitch: Govern 4-part skill layout, registry triggers, JIT progressive disclosure, and 100% plugin bundle mirror parity.
skill-governance.purpose: Keep SKILL.md entrypoints concise, orphaned assets forbidden, and plugin bundles byte-identical to .agents/skills/.
situations: Create or trim skills inside 50-300 line JIT window budgets
Sync registry metadata, skill-catalog.md, and plugin mirrors
Resolve missing error-rule pointers or dead relative links

sparse-moe-and-ast-routing.pitch: Govern 5-tier Sparse MoE routing, uint32 bitmasks, LineFeatureTape, lazy AST/CFG projection, and analyzer pooling.
sparse-moe-and-ast-routing.purpose: Ensure 32-bit unsigned bitmask parity (Bit 31), zero eager parsing, and O(1) resetState() reuse across analyzers.
situations: Preserve unsigned (bit >>> 0) indexing on AnalyzerBit 0..31
Move expensive checks behind LineFeatureTape flags and fast triggers
Use NormalizedAst / oxc-parser slices without secondary parsing
verification: cd auto-refactor && npm test && node scripts/bench-hot-paths.js

spec-driven-development.pitch: Clarify ambiguous specs one question at a time, expose X-Y traps, and lock contracts before architecture edits.
spec-driven-development.purpose: Eliminate costly rework by resolving ambiguity and interface boundaries prior to touching code.
situations: A vague feature request hides conflicting edge constraints
Cross-subsystem changes risk an X-Y detour without contract sign-off
Major refactoring requires staged plan approval before coding

state-concurrency-and-crash-recovery.pitch: Enforce symmetric resource disposal, bounded queues, idempotent journal replay, and atomic temp-rename durability.
state-concurrency-and-crash-recovery.purpose: Prevent leaked timers/handles, OOM socket buffers, and torn writes across async dispatchers and recovery paths.
situations: Bind socket read caps, drain backpressure, and worker rssGuard
Guarantee symmetric dispose/timer cleanup on daemon shutdown
Make WAL/journal replay idempotent across abrupt process kills

subagent-orchestration.pitch: 派发或编排 SubAgent、处理五层上下文预算治理(75% 脱水)时必须使用。强制同构模型、独占 Zero-Intersection Path Jail 物理防冲突与交叉复审。
subagent-orchestration.purpose: 回答『这个任务怎么拆给子 Agent 且不互相覆盖文件』，产出派发契约与隔离边界。
situations: 两个子 Agent 同时改同一批文件
主会话上下文到 75% 需要脱水
派发审查型子 Agent 却给了写权限

taxis-daemon-and-agent-control.pitch: Govern Taxis persistent daemon IPC, fg-native N-API, blackboard leases, quarantine, FGT-MSG/gate-slice, and TS UI.
taxis-daemon-and-agent-control.purpose: Guard resident Taxis IPC/N-API parity, multi-agent DiskBlackboardStore write mutexes, live Praxis/PROM gates, and binary git diffs.
situations: Modify persistent taxis daemon IPC caching or fg-native N-API bridge
Enforce DiskBlackboardStore leases, quarantine restore, or gate-slice
Run real taxis vs git binary parity (--require-taxis) or TS tests

telemetry-statistical-modeling.pitch: Enforce zero-padded telemetry, Jeffreys Beta(0.5,0.5) posteriors, CAI 2.0, and BLOCK_GAMING_DETECTED circuit breaking.
telemetry-statistical-modeling.purpose: Keep scoring engines mathematically sound with empty-baseline calibration checks and anti-gaming detection.
situations: Verify effectiveApply multipliers and harvest-calibration outcomes
Compute Jeffreys credible intervals or Popoviciu polyglot balance
Detect low semantic churn regressions triggering BLOCK_GAMING_DETECTED

test-benchmark-engineering.pitch: Enforce red-green TDD, deterministic clocks/seeds, suite-manifest closure, and monotonic benchmark ratchets.
test-benchmark-engineering.purpose: Require reproducible failing tests before fixes, register new suites cleanly, and guard timing/latency ratchets.
situations: Register new validation scripts inside test-parallel manifest
Speed up isolated Rust integration harnesses without shared drift
Replace non-deterministic wall clocks or RNGs in unit specs

tiered-cache-and-wal-persistence.pitch: Govern L1/L2/L3 caches, ARC2 tail truncation, DAG invalidation, checkpointSync fallbacks, and PID-salted atomic WAL.
tiered-cache-and-wal-persistence.purpose: Prevent OOM cache blowups, stale downstream graph hits, and half-written state across crashes and restarts.
situations: Truncate corrupt ARC2 L2 delta tails before appending new frames
Add synchronous checkpoint fallback when worker threads fail
Evict transitive DAG dependents only on public signature mutations

webgames-workflow.pitch: Enforce GameConfig-driven logic, zero view-layer math, apply_snapshot decoupling, and zero loop alloc (ADV-PRF-002).
webgames-workflow.purpose: Keep Godot/GDScript domains decoupled from presentation nodes and free of per-frame heap allocations.
situations: Move domain state transitions out of frontend Godot views
Pool nodes and pre-allocate buffers to clear ADV-PRF-002
Align GameConfig fields with snapshot bindings and headless tests

workspace-timing-dev.pitch: Govern workspace-timing 5-layer decoupling, RingBuffer+Journal crash safety, zh-CN/en i18n parity, and dark UI.
workspace-timing-dev.purpose: Guard VS Code timing persistence across midnights/kills, strict declaration flags, and 100% bilingual UI parity.
situations: Harden RingBuffer + journal recovery across midnight rollovers
Add bilingual zh-CN and en strings for new dashboard telemetry
Keep tsconfig declaration:false and 5-layer imports clean
verification: cd workspace-timing && npm run compile && npm run test:fast && npm run review
